size.note: Wikipedia gives 19–23 cm. Newman has no species page.

habitat: Wikipedia says that on migration and in winter it is typically found in freshwater habitats. Newman has no species page.
summary: Newman has no species page. Wikipedia describes a grey-brown back, brownest in the summer male and greyest in winter, and a grey breast sharply demarcated at its lower edge. The legs are yellowish and the bill is olive with a darker tip. The voice is not described. Avibase marks the Kruger occurrence rare or accidental, so the months are unset. No Kemp estimate is stored.

sources.title: Avibase bird checklist — Kruger National Park

head.pattern: The back is brownest in the summer male and greyest in winter. The head is not given a separate colour.

upperparts.pattern: Grey-brown back, brownest in the summer male and greyest in winter.

underparts.pattern: Grey breast, sharply demarcated at its lower edge.

viewNotes.note: Grey-brown back and yellowish legs. The bill is olive with a darker tip.
Grey breast, sharply cut off at the lower edge.
The summer male has the brownest back.
The back is greyest in winter.
The underside in flight is not described.

calls.description: Wikipedia does not describe the voice. No recording from South Africa was found. The selected file is a grade A call from Washington. The filename is XC109917-Pectoral Sandpiper2012-9-8-2.mp3.
